verdict.rationale: Fastmail is a hosted email service, and whether its app can be self-hosted is a fair question for an email product, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows that Fastmail's app or mail pipeline can be self-hosted. JMAP being an open standard that others can implement, and a bare 'Open source and standards' page title, are protocol-level building blocks, not a self-hostable Fastmail product.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
